# Record clear architecture decisions

Document the reasoning behind technical decisions while that reasoning is still available to the people who made them.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use when authoring or updating an architecture decision record, using the project’s format and authority.

Example request:

> Record why we chose a shared queue, including alternatives, the pending latency check and when to reconsider.

Expected result: A decision record with context, options, outcome, consequences and explicit evidence status.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** The shared queue is chosen for a prototype. Latency has not been measured, so meeting the target is still a pending claim.

**Before**

> The shared queue is the best option and will meet the latency target.

**After**

> Choose the shared queue for this prototype. Measure latency before claiming the target is met; record what result would trigger reconsideration.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.7.0 --skill record-architecture-decisions
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/record-architecture-decisions/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/record-architecture-decisions/references/decisions.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

MADR informs the decision structure, while source checks preserve the status and authority of the decision. The guidance helps maintainers understand why an approach was selected, particularly after the original participants have moved on and the meeting that settled the matter has become a distant organisational legend.

- [MADR](https://adr.github.io/madr/)

The [source-to-guidance map](../../standards/framework-evidence.md) explains how these sources inform the skill and which decisions are local.
